name: fleet-gauge
description: Weekly and five-hour usage with reset times, context fill, a compact suggestion at a threshold you set, optional auto-compact, and each subagent's call count.

compact_at.title: Suggest compacting at (% of the window)
compact_at.description: The band turns yellow and a toast suggests /compact once context reaches this share of the window.

auto_compact.title: Auto-compact
auto_compact.description: Compact the conversation after a turn ends once context reaches the auto-compact share. Off unless you turn it on.

auto_compact_at.title: Auto-compact at (% of the window)
auto_compact_at.description: Used only when auto-compact is on.
